paragraphs: So it is cited in Yuhasin. And he is mentioned in Bava Kamma 117b in the Pesaro printing; and he was the colleague of Rabbi Elazar. But our reading has Rabbi Shimon ben Elyakim.[^1]

notes.text: The complete Bava Kamma 117b paragraphs name Rabbi Shimon ben Elyakim and Rabbi Elazar ben Pedat and describe their joint adjudication. Hyman’s Yuchasin and Pesaro reports use Yochanan instead; those specific witnesses were not freshly collated. His colleague statement is retained without merging Yochanan and Shimon or admitting a new identity.
